resources.string: Lets your organisation\'s Nigafiy Fleet lock this phone, require a screen lock, turn the camera off, install or remove work apps and erase the phone. Every action is logged in Fleet.
Shown while Nigafiy manages this phone

On the computer: Fleet → Enroll endpoint → Android. Then press Scan QR code here and point the phone at the code on the screen. Or paste the link, or type the three values.
That is not a Nigafiy enrollment code. In Fleet, open Enroll endpoint → Android and scan the app link code.
The QR scanner is not available on this phone (%1$s). Use Paste or type the values.
Nothing to paste: copy the link or the ldea_ token first.
This phone is managed by Nigafiy
Mode: Device Owner (lock, wipe, camera, screen-lock policy and app installs available to your IT)
Mode: regular app (inventory and security checks only; IT cannot lock or erase this phone)
Allow Nigafiy to run in the background

What Nigafiy reads: model, Android version and security patch, storage, memory, battery, network addresses, installed apps and the security settings listed in Fleet. It never reads messages, photos, contacts, location or what you type. IT can also ask to see your screen (you are asked every time), control it if you turned that on in Accessibility, open your shared files if you allowed All files access, ring the phone and send you a message. Each of these is shown on the phone while it happens.
Your organisation erased this phone through Nigafiy.
%1$s rang this phone so it can be found. Tap Stop to end it.
IT asks to see your screen
%1$s asks to see your screen. Reason: %2$s
If you share, they see your whole screen, including notifications, until you or they stop. Android will ask you once more. Nothing is recorded on the phone.
Remote control is on: they can also tap, swipe and press Back, Home and Recent apps. A bar stays on top of the screen while they can.
They can only look: remote control is off on this phone.
%1$s can see your screen. Tap Stop to end it.
%1$s can see and control your screen. Tap Stop to end it.
Lets IT tap and swipe on this phone, only during a screen-sharing session you accepted, while a bar on top of the screen says so. Nigafiy never reads what is on the screen or what you type.
Screen view: IT must ask you every time, and Android asks again.
Remote control: on (only during a screen session you accept).
Remote control: off. To allow it, turn on Nigafiy in Accessibility.
File manager: allowed (shared storage only: Download, DCIM, Documents…).
File manager: not allowed. To allow it, turn on All files access for Nigafiy.
Ring and messages: IT can ring this phone and show you a message. Both appear as notifications.
